mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market discounts economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) below 600 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 million dollars indicate weakening consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 380000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 indicates manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate output and profitability, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market discounts reduced economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 90 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600 reflect robust consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in continued growth momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 600 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225 indicates accelerating inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations to generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market (PAYEMS < 130,000) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals recession risk from both demand and monetary factors, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 130000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: GDP level above 13,000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 13000) indicates late-cycle economic expansion where market overvaluation and slowing growth generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 13000 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
